title: Upfront Loading vs Deferred Loading
brief: A flat-tech infographic side-by-side comparison for a technical blog. Right 'Deferred loading with Tool Search': only a tool catalog + a few non-deferred tools + the tool_search tool live in context; the rest wait in a warehouse.
